title: New customer books a minor service

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks for calling Riverbend Auto Service, this is Charlie. How can I help today?

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Hi Charlie, I’d like to book a minor service for my 2016 Toyota Corolla.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: No worries, I can help with that. Can I have your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks, Nadia. What's the registration number for your Corolla?

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Great, and just to confirm, what sort of car is it? I have a 2016 Toyota Corolla.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks for that. Can I have a contact number, just in case I need to reach you?

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks, Nadia. Is there anything else we should look at while the car is in for the minor service?

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: No, I don’t need anything extra. Just the minor service, please.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text:
For the minor service, it's normally between one hundred and eighty and two hundred and sixty dollars, and we'd need the car for about an hour and a half. 

I have a few slots available: Wednesday the twenty-eighth at eight, at eight thirty, or at nine. Which one suits you?

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: I can do Wednesday the twenty-eighth at eight.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Perfect! Just to confirm, that's a minor service on the Corolla, rego R V B four four two, for Nadia Okafor, on Wednesday the twenty-eighth at eight. Is that all right?

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text:
You're booked in for a minor service on Wednesday the twenty-eighth at eight, reference B K zero zero one. The estimate is one hundred and eighty to two hundred and sixty dollars, and the final price is confirmed after we inspect it. 

Thanks for calling Riverbend Auto Service, see you then!

transcript.speaker: Nadia
transcript.text: Thank you, Charlie. See you then!

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks for calling Riverbend Auto Service, see you then!
